stories.title: PM Modi's three-nation tour: Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand (7–11 July)
stories.body: the first Indian PM visit to New Zealand in 40 years; ties elevated to a Strategic Partnership with a 'Roadmap to 2030'; target to double bilateral trade to ₹35,000 crore by 2030; FTA talks to be fast-tracked.

stories.title: PM Modi conferred 'Bintang Adipurna'
stories.body: Indonesia's highest civilian honour, by President Prabowo Subianto in Jakarta on 7 July, for strengthening India–Indonesia relations; Modi dedicates it to the people of India.
